qualification: Primary documentation/source facts; Linux runtime remains unverified. Source tag pins are not claims of current latest versions.

sources.facts: Stats.blocks is the allocated block count. Stats.blksize is the I/O block size. The blocks section does not specify a portable byte unit.
Darwin documentation gives 512-byte allocation units; a short symlink can report zero blocks.

sources.section: Number of blocks allocated to the file (st_blocks)
sources.facts: Linux counts 512-byte blocks; st_blksize is not that unit. POSIX does not universally specify the st_blocks unit.
Unix mapping assigns the native st_blocks field to the libuv stat result unchanged; stat/lstat use this mapping or the Linux statx path.
The Linux mapping assigns stx_blocks to st_blocks unchanged.
